structural_change: HBM-HCBANK6 10-20 (H.STA.BLK.17.2) structural successor of hbm_hcq_hub_s1/s1b/s2/s2b (all --cts gates FAILED: GATE_STALL rc137 in post-CTS repair_timing -hold, 28,269 hold endpoints at margin 30 with ONE 51,334-sink root whose arrival spread 566..849 ps; mapped native32 census 1,057 / 960 drivers > 32). (1) REGISTER MASS OUT OF THE GLUE: levels 1..4 of the quarter subtree (60 of 63 LAT-7 adders, ~37k flops) are 4 hard children ot_hbm_hc_qtree16_static (one master x4, kit hbm_hcq_tree16_c1) beside the W-face s_i pins, each with its own clock entry clk_t[c] (hybrid_entries: the die delivers phi - R per entry; the glue root clk keeps ~14k sinks); (2) native32 RTL SAFE 2 (0 added edges, same edges as SAFE 1): native-fanout LAT-7 adders, F20 target FAN32, programme FAN32, gathered reader f32, result store f32, residual 128 x 16-b capture copies, gather-phase copies, kept-synchroniser relays <= 31 copies; (3) reset landing 2 stages with 2 first / 8 final copies + reset_relay_split 32.  HBM-HC7-QHUB 10-20: children ON the 43.2 lattice (the HCBANK6 y 367.2/583.2 were half-lattice and would snap into an overlap): x 43.2, y 216.0/345.6/475.2/604.8 (c1: 97.2-tall slices, 32.4 channels), beside the W-face s_i pins (368.7..727.1); native32 RTL completed (census of the glue with the kit reset split: see README). FAM-HBM-C/C-QHUB 10-21 c1p: c1 geometry + W-face s_i/clk_t pins moved down to the slice stack (bank_distance fix, see slot_change_request). HBM-COLLECT10/HCQB 10-21: c1p-9a9e8c85b crashed twice in 3_3_place_gp (RSZ-3006: load pin ...g_native7.u_native.c904/B1 dont_touch; the native LAT-7 graph carries keep+dont_touch on every cell and the hub's PRE_GLOBAL_PLACE hook lacked the tree16 kits' native_untouch) -> PRE_GLOBAL_PLACE = hc_hub_band_native_gpl.tcl (native_untouch + band). Not a blocked region / halo / fence: the net sits in the open central band. c1q (fallback twin of c1p): identical kit + GPL_TIMING_DRIVEN=0, so global placement runs no resizer buffering at all (repair_design/repair_timing run after placement on the untouched graph).
